title: Purple Warrior Pose Sequence
description: Four sequential views of a muscular dark-skinned female warrior with long white hair, wearing purple and silver fantasy armor with bare midriff and legs. She is shown in dynamic fighting stances, from casting a purple energy orb to delivering a powerful kick surrounded by exploding purple crystalline energy effects.
prompt: A dark-skinned female warrior with flowing white hair and purple fantasy armor with silver details, shown in four sequential action poses against a black background. She casts a glowing purple orb, performs a mid-air kick, unleashes an explosive burst of purple crystalline energy shards, and stands in a ready stance. Muscular build, bare midriff, dynamic movement, dramatic purple energy effects, fantasy style, high detail.
